tasks.task: Profile an export before anyone trusts it

items.when: When a CSV or Excel export arrives and you need to know what is wrong with it first
When the data is new to you, to map its structure, spread, links and odd spots
When you need gaps, duplicates and odd values listed with the rules that would catch them

tasks.task: Write clean-up rules for a messy dataset

items.when: When dates, names, phones, categories and duplicates need numbered rules and steps
When the mess is spacing, numbers stored as text, mixed dates and repeated rows
When thousands of rows need a few tested fix rules, a change log and a risky-row list
When the file must be fixed and rechecked until it passes, with the rules saved

tasks.task: Merge several exports or reports into one table

items.when: When several files with different columns must become one table with a key
After the join, to explain unmatched rows and duplicate keys before totals are used

tasks.task: Write a refreshable recipe for a monthly export

items.when: When someone fixes the same export by hand each month and wants a refresh instead
Before the recipe, to write the clean-up rules it must apply
When Power Query does not fit, to try a small script or schedule that does the same job
When the steps stay manual, to write exact steps, fixes if it fails and how to undo
When the recipe feeds formulas, to find errors and broken links after a refresh

tasks.task: Turn a clean data file into a checked insight brief

items.when: When the file is clean and you need the question, a short answer and up to five findings
When you want a guided run from raw file and question to a ranked, checked brief
When the question needs trends, tests and correlations worked from the data
Before the brief is shared, to check the method, the maths and any bias
When a finding is exciting, to match the claim to the evidence and run a second check

tasks.task: Take a business question through to a decision

items.when: When an owner or committee asks a question the data might answer
Before any analysis, to see whether the data can support the answer needed
When nobody has said how sure they must be, to set how much evidence is enough
When the answer must fit one page with the decision first

tasks.task: Compare customer segments or cohorts

items.when: When groups must be compared fairly, with numbers, a caveat and an action for each
When customers should be scored on recency, frequency and spend and then grouped
When you need repeat rate and revenue for each first-purchase month
When retention by start month should be shown as a colour grid with a plain reading
Before groups are compared in a report, to check the group sizes and the maths

tasks.task: Forecast monthly sales from the business's own history

items.when: When you have history and need the simplest method that fits, ranges and update formulas
Before choosing a method, to find trend, season and odd spikes in the history
When you want a second forecast with ranges and a test on held-back months
When sales depend on known drivers and a fitted model with checks is needed
When a forecast is one confident number, to add base rates, a range and a date to score it
Before the forecast goes out, or to review last year's against what really happened

tasks.task: Forecast weekly covers, bookings or orders

items.when: When a kitchen, clinic or shop needs next week's numbers by day with a range
When the forecast must turn into a weekly make plan within capacity
When the forecast should set how many staff cover each busy hour
Before staff or stock are planned on it, to check the method and the range

tasks.task: Forecast from open deals and split a target by month

items.when: When you have a pipeline export and need commit, best case and pipeline-only views
When next year's target must be split by month using the real seasonal pattern
When the forecast is drafted, to test pipeline cover and past forecast accuracy

tasks.task: Benchmark the client's numbers against public figures

items.when: When you have the client's numbers and published figures and need a fair gap table
When the client wants a financial health and ratio sheet from their accounts
When a public figure will be quoted, to check it against its source first
When one gap looks dramatic, to compare spread, dates and proportions before judging

tasks.task: Write a survey read-out with honest caveats

items.when: When a customer, parent, member or staff survey needs a fair summary for a meeting
When the read-out must become a briefing with a findings table and slide notes
When open comments need themes ranked by how often they come up, with quotes
When some answers may flatter, to score how far each question can be trusted
When a small sample is quoted as fact, to say what is still unknown in plain words

tasks.task: Refresh a monthly report when the new export lands

items.when: Each month, to run the same checks, refresh and comment steps in order
When dated records must roll up to monthly counts and totals you can trace
When each line that moved past a limit needs a written reason
When the workbook has pivots, to set a safe refresh order and find stale ones
Before the report is sent, to catch wrong totals and broken formulas

tasks.task: Write a season, term or year report for a club or charity

items.when: When registers and results must become a short report with findings and actions
When attendance and no-shows need a reconciled table and the patterns behind them
When the report reads as a table, to try it as a story with the point and proof
Before the report goes to print or funders, to check facts, numbers and names

tasks.task: Report donor retention and segment the next appeal

items.when: When gift history must show who stayed, who lapsed and what each appeal raised
When donors should be grouped by how recently, how often and how much they gave
When retention by first-gift year should be shown as a grid
When segments are set and the appeal needs gift amounts and measures to track
Before trustees see it, to check donor counts, periods and any double counting

tasks.task: Design a register or tracker for members and attendance

items.when: When volunteers will enter records and need dropdowns and checks on each cell
When the tracker will be run by someone else and needs a check and a guide

tasks.task: Make charts for a report or funder pack

items.when: When you have the data and need a clean chart of the right type
When you want to try several chart types on the file quickly before choosing
When a chart is drafted, to check the type, axes and colours do not mislead
When a chart shows everything and the reader cannot see the point

tasks.task: Write a script or query for one data task

items.when: When the file is too big for a spreadsheet and you need code you can rerun
When the data sits in a database and the need can be said in plain words
Before a query's result is relied on, to find wrong-result risks and slow spots

tasks.task: Review a CRM pipeline or win-loss record

items.when: Before any reading, to list missing fields, stale dates and stage mismatches
When you need coverage, ageing and conversion stage by stage
When closed deals should show where and why the firm wins and loses

tasks.task: Check a file before it is imported into another system

items.when: When a file is about to be imported and must be profiled against the target's rules
When each source column needs a target column, a rule and any open gap written down
When rows that will fail or create duplicates must be found before the import

tasks.task: Find out why a number moved

items.when: When a number moved and you must confirm it, split it by group and rank the drivers
When you only have before and after figures, to rank likely causes and what to check
When the move may be a counting change, to find where two reports split

tasks.task: Analyse product sales: margin, pairs and price

items.when: When you have revenue and cost by product and need each margin and the loss makers
When order lines should show which products are bought together
When the data suggests a price change, to set three cases and a test you can undo
When sales and cost tables are joined, to find products that failed to match

tasks.task: Check whether a difference in the numbers is real

items.when: Before testing, to see whether the sample can show the difference at all
When you need the right test, its assumption checks and the effect size

tasks.task: Explain the method and its limits in plain words

items.when: When readers ask how you did it, to write a plain section with the limits
When findings are full of analyst words and the reader is an owner or trustee
When someone else must be able to repeat the analysis from your notes
When a striking number is about to be shared, to say what it counts and what it leaves out
Before the write-up goes out, to mark each line proven, likely or a guess

always.when: Before any analysis, when the request does not say what decision the answer feeds
Before any finding is sent, to separate what the data shows from what is assumed
Before a report is sent, to catch typos and a measure named two ways

helpers.when: When the data needs a dictionary, weekly quality checks, a duplicate merge plan or a made-up test file
When the answer should live on as a dashboard or a regular KPI report
When charts need accessible colours, an infographic or a designed results deck
When the question needs a formal test, an experiment design or a model review
When the fix is a rebuilt workbook with formulas, lookups or macros
When a survey must be designed or outside market figures must be found and judged

gaps: No library item writes Power Query steps or Google Sheets clean-up formulas; only the kit prompt covers refreshable recipes
No library item standardises dates, names, phone numbers and addresses by rule for a given country
No library item checks last year's sales forecast against actuals; the only backtest item is for cash forecasts
No library item splits an annual sales target by month from the seasonal pattern
No library item compares a firm's numbers with published benchmarks like for like, or finds trade body and official figures
No library item reports donor retention, lapsed donors or appeal results by segment and channel from a gift export
No library item analyses attendance and drop-out for a club, class or school term
No library item designs a member register or attendance tracker; only general Excel form builders exist
No library item builds a messy test file to prove a clean-up recipe works
No library item makes survey cross-tabs with small-base warnings or weighting
